An ancient '''Sith tome''' was kept at the [[Sith Academy (Dromund Kaas)|academy]] on the ancestral [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The manuscript was more than 10,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old<ref name="Revan" /> by [[3954 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> and was dated to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the arrival of the first [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] on Dromund Kaas and their interactions with the native [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]]. Considered one of the [[Sith academy|academy's]] greatest [[Sith artifact/Legends|treasures]], the [[Book/Legends|tome]] was the only physical artifact the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] had seen during his time there as an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]].<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith tome's was mentioned in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2011]] novel [[The Old Republic: Revan|''Revan'']], the third in a series based on the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Revan" />
